differences.title: 1. ROUTING
differences.leftDesc: Standard nested routing with layout conventions for simpler structure.
differences.rightDesc: App Router & Pages Router offer flexibility, can be complex.

differences.title: 2. DATA LOADING
differences.leftDesc: Uses `loader` functions for server-side data fetching before render.

differences.title: 3. MUTATIONS
differences.leftDesc: Built-in `action` functions handle form submissions and data updates.
differences.rightDesc: Requires separate API routes or libraries for data mutations.

differences.title: 4. RENDERING
differences.leftDesc: Primarily Server-Side Rendering for dynamic, always-fresh content.
differences.rightDesc: Offers static generation, server rendering, and incremental static regeneration.

differences.title: 5. DEPENDENCIES
differences.leftDesc: Less reliance on React hooks; focuses on web standards.
differences.rightDesc: Deeply integrated with React, leverages its ecosystem heavily.

differences.title: 6. ERROR HANDLING
differences.leftDesc: Error boundaries are part of the routing system.
differences.rightDesc: Requires manual implementation using Error Boundaries component.

differences.title: 7. DEPLOYMENT
differences.leftDesc: Works well with most Node.js servers and serverless platforms.
differences.rightDesc: Best performance and features on Vercel, but supports others.
